invoice.notPosted: Only a posted invoice can be cancelled.
invoice.cancelPaid: {paid} has been paid on it. Reverse those payments on the supplier’s page first — the money returns to the treasury and the invoice is owed again — then cancel it.

Those movements were costed with this invoice in the average, so cancelling it now would leave the stock value wrong. Cancelling can’t fix this: correct a wrong quantity with a physical count on the product; a wrong price needs a supplier credit note, which the system doesn’t have yet.

count.hint: Type what is really there now — cash and bank together. The difference from the books is recorded. Anything entered later with an earlier date won’t change the treasury again.

months.openingHint: An export only covers the months you downloaded, so the balance it describes is relative. Enter the balance noon showed before your earliest import, and every later balance follows from it.

products.noCost: No cost recorded, so profit can’t be calculated.

payments.recordHint: Money received from {customer} for this invoice.
payments.reverseDescription: For a payment recorded by mistake: {amount} leaves the cash and the customer owes it again. The payment stays in the history, marked as reversed.

voucher.editHint: Saving cancels the original and records this corrected one. Both stay in the treasury history.
voucher.cancelHint: For a voucher entered by mistake. Its amount is reversed in the treasury; the voucher stays in the history, marked cancelled.

expense.editHint: Saving cancels the original and records this corrected one. Both stay in the expense history.

payment.reverseHint: For a payment recorded by mistake: {amount} comes back to the treasury and the supplier is owed it again. The payment stays in the history, marked reversed.

invoice.editHint: A posted invoice can’t be changed in place — its goods are already in stock and its amount in the books. Editing works in three steps:
invoice.cancelHintCredit: For an invoice entered by mistake. Its goods leave stock, the cost average goes back to what it was, and the supplier is no longer owed it. It stays visible, marked cancelled.
invoice.cancelHintCash: For an invoice entered by mistake. Its goods leave stock, the cost average goes back to what it was, and the cash paid returns to the treasury. It stays visible, marked cancelled.
invoice.banner: Cancelled on {date} by {name} — {reason}. Its goods left stock and its amount left the books.
invoice.correctionOf: This draft re-enters a cancelled invoice — fix it and post it to take its place.
invoice.editStep1: This invoice is cancelled: its goods leave stock and its amount leaves the books.
invoice.editStep2: A new draft opens with the same supplier and lines.
invoice.editStep3: You fix what’s wrong and post it — it takes this invoice’s place.
